terminals.name: api
terminals.command: cd src/api && . .venv/bin/activate && FLASK_APP=app.py exec gunicorn -k gevent -w 1 -b 0.0.0.0:5800 app:app --timeout 300 --log-level info --access-logfile -
terminals.description: AI-Shifu Flask backend API on port 5800 (gunicorn/gevent).

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: cd src/cook-web && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 exec npm run dev -- -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3000
terminals.description: Cook Web Next.js frontend (learner + authoring console) on port 3000. Proxies /api to the backend.
